verdict.rationale: Aider is documented only as a locally run CLI and experimental browser UI that edits code in your local git repo. It does have local test-running features (/test, --auto-test) and one-shot scripting (--message), but nothing in the evidence shows a cloud-hosted agent that autonomously builds, tests, and demos a feature for review. The 'navigator-mode' autonomy is a community add-on, not a first-party capability, and still runs locally.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review
